scripts.preinstall: node -e "try { require('fs').unlinkSync('package-lock.json'); } catch(e){} try { require('fs').unlinkSync('yarn.lock'); } catch(e){} const ua = process.env.npm_config_user_agent || ''; if (!ua.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.warn('Note: pnpm recommended; proceeding with current package manager.'); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.build:render: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile=false && PORT=10000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:api
scripts.start:render: pnpm run db:push && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run start
